description: Create or revise durable background work. The worker does not receive this conversation, so work must be self-contained: include the subject, scope or location, absolute dates and range meaning, constraints, and corrections from memory. For a revision, restate the whole corrected task and include task_id; omit task_id to create. Asynchronous: queues and returns immediately.

work.description: Self-contained instructions for a worker that cannot see the conversation or chat memory. Include the exact subject, scope or location, absolute dates including year and range meaning (for example inclusive nights versus checkout date), constraints, prior corrections, and what evidence to return. Never use a fragment such as 'check availability on those dates.' For a revision, restate the entire corrected task, not just the change.

done_when.description: Specific, evidence-based condition that proves the user's full request is satisfied. Preserve the scope, date-range meaning, and constraints from work; do not reduce it to a generic condition such as 'availability confirmed.'

task_id.description: Existing task to revise. Only use a task_id supplied in your input; never invent one.
